source: User proposal and repository viability assessment

discovery.problem: Sequential issue execution underuses independent DAG frontiers and local detached agents cannot govern remote resources durably.

decisions: Create a separate control-plane skill instead of expanding worktree-swarm monolithically.
Keep land-by-wave as the default dependency convergence strategy.
Expose local-worktree and argv-only vm-pool providers.
Keep agents, models, and environments behind a portable worker profile and a dependency-free runner; no vendor-specific default.
Never persist secret values and never clean resources without ownership tokens.
